plainText:
Kali (Japanese: キリカ Kirika) is a from the Laverre Gym. In , she is a recurring character who first appeared in A Fashionable Battle!.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
==== ====
Kali is a loyal to Laverre City Gym Leader Valerie. She was first shown ordering other Furisode Girls around in preparation for a fashion show showcasing Valerie's fashion collection. She later appeared as one of the announcers of the fashion show and refereed a Gym between Valerie and Sawyer that was part of the fashion show.

Kali reappeared in Fairy-Type Trickery!, acting as the referee of and Valerie's Gym battle.

She reappeared in a flashback in Till We Compete Again!.

====Voice actors====
 

==In the core series games==
Kali appears in Pokémon X and Y as one of the s in the Laverre Gym.

==In the spin-off games==
===Pokémon Masters EX===
 
Kali forms a sync pair with in Pokémon Masters EX. Kali became a playable sync pair on January 1, 2023.
